* Demonstrates responsible decision-making in planning, delegating, and providing care based on patient needs and organizational policies.

* Engages in professional development to maintain clinical competency and understanding of current nursing standards and regulations.

* Strong knowledge of the nursing process and clinical nursing practices.
* Ability to perform thorough patient assessments and communicate findings effectively.
* Proficient in administering medications and monitoring for side effects.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with interdisciplinary teams.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting patient care.
* Knowledge of safety standards, infection control, and quality improvement initiatives.

Overjet is the global-leader in dental AI. Already, thousands of dental providers and insurers rely on our platform to deliver the best possible care. We’re looking for talented people to fulfill our mission, starting with improving oral health for all.

THE ROLE

Our enterprise customers don't have one workflow. They have hundreds of workflows, a dozen systems, processes that live in people's heads, and business units which each measure success differently. They also have really important missions to serve patients and Overjet exists to help them do this more effectively.

Forward Deployed Engineers close the gap between what Overjet’s platform does today and what our largest customers need it to do. You’ll embed with enterprises, learn how their operation runs, and then build, integrate, and ship whatever it takes to make Overjet's agentic products work there. You own the result, from the first discovery call to the moment an operator at a customer uses it.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Embed with enterprise customers to understand their clinical, operational, and financial workflows, and translate vague goals into scoped, buildable plans.

 - Build and own production integrations between Overjet and customer systems. 

 - Build custom AI agent workflows on top of Overjet’s agentic platform.

 - Work directly with stakeholders at every level of the org chart.

 - Operate safely inside a regulated environment. 

 - Bring field lessons back to Overjet. When you build the same thing twice, work with Product and Platform Engineering so nobody has to build it a third time.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience building AI-powered workflows and agents. When you apply, show us what you have built.

 - Ownership of outcomes. You measure success by whether the customer’s problem is solved, not by whether your ticket is closed.

 - Comfort in ambiguity. You can make good decisions with incomplete information.

 - Technical range. Strong proficiency in programming languages with the ability to learn anything you need to.

 - Clear communication. You can explain a data model to an engineer and a rollout risk to an executive in the same afternoon.

 - Willingness to travel up to 50% to customer sites.
